classifications.rationale: The President announces an immediately effective amendment to an existing proclamation, but this introductory segment does not itself specify a substantive change in legal rights or duties.
classifications.evidence: effective as of the date of this Proclamation

classifications.rationale: The amendment gives the Secretary discretionary authority to permit excess imports after specified findings; it does not require a particular allocation or itself grant one.

Although much of the segment authorizes discretionary interim allocations, it also requires the Secretary to impose a specified later reduction on any subsequent allocation received by an interim-allocation recipient.
classifications.evidence: shall be reduced by an amount equal to the interim allocation
